thesis_chain: Abundant Intelligence -> Scarce Complements -> Bottleneck Migration -> Economic Capture -> Capital Allocation

lanes.world_change: AI models increase bandwidth, packaging and test intensity
lanes.scarce_complement: HBM, advanced packaging, process control and known-good-die test
rejected_or_parked_examples: Montage Technology: valuation removed current asymmetry
private_or_uninvestable_benchmarks: EV Group: private hybrid-bonding equipment benchmark
lanes.remaining_gap: Further names are likely correlated with the existing memory cycle; a new architecture or materially better asymmetry is required.
rescan_triggers: new package or memory architecture changes the limiting step
new qualification or order evidence outside existing candidates
valuation or capacity reset changes relative asymmetry

lanes.world_change: AI data-centre load increases the value of deliverable power and speed to energisation
lanes.scarce_complement: generation, transformers, grid equipment and interconnection execution
rejected_or_parked_examples: 800 VDC narrow supplier concentration: no Gate-A candidate
transformer inputs: weaker capture than equipment
lanes.remaining_gap: Several real second-order bottlenecks have private or diluted public ownership; existing lanes dominate current coverage.
rescan_triggers: new physical bottleneck outside the mapped system
funded orders make a second-order layer company-material

lanes.world_change: AI rack power rises toward architectures that reduce conversion stages and copper losses
lanes.scarce_complement: qualified DC protection, conversion and distribution at rack and row level
rejected_or_parked_examples: ABB: credible platform but no concentrated lock-in
Schneider Electric: strong exposure but diluted company sensitivity
nVent/Eaton/Vertiv: relevant broader platforms without a separate narrow 800 VDC promotion
lanes.remaining_gap: The architecture is credible, but no narrow supplier concentration or company-transforming economics cleared Gate A.
rescan_triggers: named platform standard and production award
qualified component shortage or pricing power
revenue mix becomes material to a listed supplier

lanes.world_change: AI rack density raises heat flux and liquid-loop reliability requirements
lanes.scarce_complement: heat rejection, CDUs, cold plates, manifolds and leak-free quick disconnects
rejected_or_parked_examples: broad incumbents: insufficient company-transforming purity
Auras: primary financial and qualification evidence insufficient
lanes.remaining_gap: Component qualification, order contribution and margins remain weakly disclosed.
rescan_triggers: cooling product mix or margin disclosure

lanes.world_change: Physical AI moves from prototypes toward repeatable robot production
lanes.scarce_complement: precision reducers, screws, motors and integrated actuator industrialisation
rejected_or_parked_examples: brakes and locks: deprioritised
common components without named production evidence
lanes.remaining_gap: Architecture share, named OEM production and unit economics remain uncertain across many component families.
rescan_triggers: new production evidence makes a common component scarce

lanes.world_change: Autonomous physical systems require predictable control and certifiable safety
lanes.scarce_complement: deterministic runtime, functional safety and cross-OEM certification
rejected_or_parked_examples: large industrial incumbents: humanoid contribution too diluted
private_or_uninvestable_benchmarks: Robotiq and other private safety specialists
lanes.remaining_gap: Recurring software economics, transaction dilution and protection from platform bundling remain unresolved.

lanes.world_change: Physical AI requires local inference under power, latency and deployment constraints
lanes.scarce_complement: production-qualified edge compute and industrial deployment infrastructure
rejected_or_parked_examples: broad architecture exposure without company-level asymmetry
lanes.remaining_gap: AI-specific incremental margins and recurring deployment economics are often unisolated.
rescan_triggers: production design-in converts to disclosed revenue
margin or backlog inflection tied to Physical AI

lanes.world_change: Physical AI policies need sim-to-real testing, rare-event coverage and release gating
lanes.scarce_complement: validated simulation, evaluation and continuous fleet feedback
rejected_or_parked_examples: ABB and Dassault Systemes: exposure too diluted for the theme alone
lanes.remaining_gap: The cleanest release-gating businesses are private; listed candidates must prove recurring platform economics over services.
rescan_triggers: independent validation becomes a release gate
open-source or incumbent bundling removes scarcity

lanes.world_change: Deployed robots create rare-failure and operational data unavailable from generic models
lanes.scarce_complement: rights to feedback data, cross-customer learning and fleet operations
rejected_or_parked_examples: PTC and Ambarella: indirect or diluted exposure
robot OEM captive loops: no merchant listed capture
lanes.remaining_gap: No clean listed company has demonstrated rights to pool cross-customer feedback and retain recurring economics.
rescan_triggers: listed supplier discloses reusable cross-customer data rights
private platform lists or is acquired by a material public owner
recurring fleet revenue and retention become visible

lanes.world_change: Physical intelligence needs qualified observations of geometry, motion and environment
lanes.scarce_complement: physics-constrained sensing, depth and perception modules
rejected_or_parked_examples: generic sensors without qualification or company materiality
lanes.remaining_gap: Named production volumes, sensor-specific profit and resistance to integration remain uneven.
rescan_triggers: modality or integration changes the bottleneck

lanes.world_change: AI can generate scientific hypotheses faster than labs can execute and validate them
lanes.scarce_complement: validated physical execution, measurement, orchestration and provenance
rejected_or_parked_examples: Thermo Fisher and Danaher: broad benchmark exposure with weak AI-specific materiality
generic lab robotics: weaker standalone moat
lanes.remaining_gap: Order growth, recurring attach and company-level AI materiality are unproven; provenance/QC has no clean public capture.
rescan_triggers: AI-linked automation order or utilisation inflection

lanes.world_change: Frontier AI demand expands beyond hyperscalers into distributed merchant infrastructure
lanes.scarce_complement: funded CPU/accelerator capacity and deployable distributed infrastructure
rejected_or_parked_examples: generic cloud exposure without incremental returns
lanes.remaining_gap: Capital intensity, concentration and incremental ROIC may absorb the economics.
rescan_triggers: contracted demand converts to funded utilisation

lanes.world_change: Distributed and clustered AI raises data-path orchestration requirements
rejected_or_parked_examples: broad vendors where capture and valuation are unisolated
lanes.remaining_gap: No bounded architecture-first public supplier search has established a company-transforming scarce layer.

lanes.world_change: Physical AI must connect inference to deterministic machine control
lanes.scarce_complement: industrial control, policy execution and functional integration
rejected_or_parked_examples: Siemens and broad automation incumbents: incremental Physical-AI economics unisolated
lanes.remaining_gap: Control-specific scarce economics and recurring capture have not been isolated from broad automation/services.
rescan_triggers: control becomes separately disclosed and material

lanes.world_change: Abundant agents require trusted access to enterprise systems and transactions
lanes.scarce_complement: identity, permissions, workflow integration and distribution
lanes.remaining_gap: The lane is broad and has no bounded value-chain search or tested company-capture mechanism.
rescan_triggers: bounded architecture question identifies a release gate
switching cost or transaction economics become testable
portfolio need justifies a focused scan

lanes.world_change: Model and accelerator capabilities continue to improve
lanes.scarce_complement: none by default; this is the initiating abundance layer
rejected_or_parked_examples: generic AI beneficiaries without a scarce-complement bridge
lanes.remaining_gap: Re-enter only if a specific sub-layer becomes a scarce complement rather than the initiating technology.
rescan_triggers: architecture change creates a new constrained complement inside the layer

familiarity_audit.scope: Top 20 rows of research/ranked-universe.md at 2026-09-25, classified by primary exposure
familiarity_audit.interpretation: The top 20 is concentrated in the three most familiar research programmes. This is an observable coverage bias, not proof that their ranks are wrong. Marginal discovery should prefer independent under-covered bottlenecks when evidence quality and portfolio contribution are comparable.
